text:
Kaito Sato: Quick proposal 
I want a 3-part mini-workshop series aimed at product engineers: 10-min how-to + 1 reproducible bench + an inbound flow. Small footprint, low barrier to run locally.

Maya Patel: love that. What are the three parts?

Kaito Sato: Part A: "Fast chat UI" (latency-first). Part B: "Search with embeddings" (relevance + cost). Part C: "Quant & cost trimming" (deploy on CPU). Each has a short GIF, a 1-paragraph benchmark, and a clear GitHub CTA.

Nina V: recommend micro-format: TL;DR + 5 steps + expected outputs. Keep demos to <=4 files. Add a short CONTRIBUTING.md for community PRs.

Omar Hassan: I'll trim the refapp to a minimal demo and add a run.sh that sets env vars and runs a single command. Will include a tiny config for routing between hosted/dedicated/quant.

Jamie (DevRel): For messaging lead with "Ship a prototype in 10 minutes" then show the bench as "what to expect". Also prepare a routing snippet for leads: GH issue form -> #community-handoff -> tag hubspot via ops-bot.

Kaito Sato: owners?

Maya Patel: Kaito - overall lead & blog copy. Omar - demo + run scripts. Nina - visuals + GIFs. Jamie - tutorial text + issue form. Samir usually owns bench but he's out; Omar can produce simple bench outputs and we'll ask Samir to sanity-check.

Omar Hassan: I can produce a CSV and a small png chart. Plan: run three modes (hosted credit, local batch=8, quant-CPU). Will add a short reproducibility section. ETA Tue EOD.

Nina V: design note: I'll make one hero image that works as a blog thumbnail and social card. Also will produce 3x 20s GIFs for each workshop. Need demo branch to capture screens.

Kaito Sato: inbound routing detail: GH issue template with fields (name, org, email, use-case, enterprise?). If domain looks like enterprise, ops-bot should create a high-priority task in sales queue. Non-enterprise go to #community-demos.

ops-bot: Integration ready. Need issue-form JSON in repo and webhook URL.

Jamie (DevRel): I'll author the issue-form JSON and include labels: "mini-workshop", "demo-request". Suggest we auto-assign "mentor" tag for first 50 demo requests.

Maya Patel: timeline: publish one workshop per week, small drip campaign. Week1 publish, Week2 follow-up with a community call-in, Week3 highlight top community PRs.

Kaito Sato: KPI targets: +15% repo stars over 3 weeks, >=30 demo issues, +10% newsletter signups.

Omar Hassan: small ask: can marketing allocate $75 in hosted credits for the screenshot and one hosted run?

Maya Patel: I'll request credits and confirm.

Nina V: design ask: need wireframes for GUI to record GIFs. Omar can supply dummy data.

Jamie (DevRel): social hooks: short thread + 20s GIF + link to quickstart. Use hashtag #RedwoodWorkshop. Schedule posts at 11am PT on publish days.

Kaito Sato: assets plan: demo repo under /refapps/mini-workshop/, assets hosted under /assets/mini-workshop/{csv,png,gif}. Include raw CSVs for reproducibility.

assets-bot: Created folder /assets/mini-workshop/ pending final uploads.

Maya Patel: blockers?

Jamie (DevRel): need permissions to push to repo. @repo-bot can you open refs/mini-workshop branch and add Omar and Nina?

ops-bot: Branch created: refs/mini-workshop by Kaito Sato.

Kaito Sato: I'll assemble a Notion checklist and tag owners. Quick follow-up meeting Tue 10am PT to review artifacts. Thanks team :rocket:

Maya Patel: great, I'll handle scheduling and credit request.

Omar Hassan: starting the minimal demo now.

Nina V: will prep GIF templates.

Jamie (DevRel): drafting issue form and tutorial skeleton. Will ping for review by Mon noon.

ops-bot: Reminder: review requested at 1987654325 by Kaito Sato
